comment: Body-part synonyms, consulted symmetrically when scoring reference images against a marker. Not marker knowledge and not part of any definition, so editing this file does NOT change the marker catalog signature and does NOT invalidate cached predictions. Note the asymmetric entries: 'antenna' lists 'head' but 'head' does not list 'antenna', and 'thorax' lists 'shoulder' but there is no 'shoulder' entry -- the matcher falls back to the other side's list, so those pairs still match both ways.
